_comment: Layer 1b (truth): what we actually run. Keyed <model>@<host>. Each entry names its `unit` and EITHER declares the price in that unit's fields (quoted) OR a `derive` block for self-hosted work (gpu = a key in gpu_rates.json, seconds_per_unit = measured, bench_run = the run that measured it); the pipeline computes usd_per_hour * seconds_per_unit / 3600 and names the rate it used. Every entry is attested with `note` + `verified_at` and expires like an override. A quoted per-token deployment at a catalog host is cross-checked against the per-host catalog price and any gap recorded as `drift`. Seeded 2026-09-08 from public pricing pages verified that day; replace with the hosts you actually use.

deepseek-v4-pro-0813@together.note: together.ai/pricing lists the 0813 variant; distinct from the base V4 Pro SKU

deepseek-ocr@self-host.note: PLACEHOLDER measurement: 15 s is Replicate's published typical run time for lucataco/deepseek-ocr on an L40S, treated as one page per run. Replace seconds_per_unit and bench_run with a Matterwork bench measurement.
